title: @c15t/cli: c15t's CLI
description: Generate c15t integration boilerplate, preview file edits, and configure supported applications.
features: V3 boilerplate for Next.js, React, JavaScript, TanStack Start, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, SvelteKit, Solid, and Astro
Preview and apply integration files with explicit framework wiring instructions
Use prepared local package snapshots before v3 is published
Manage hosted authentication and projects, or plan self-hosted database migrations
Structured JSON results and a reusable command runner for automation
Explicit legacy v1-to-v2 codemods with dry runs
Bundled documentation and agent skill installation
prerequisites: npm, pnpm, or yarn package manager
usage: Build the CLI from the checkout with bun run --cwd packages/cli build
Preview unpublished v3 boilerplate: node packages/cli/dist/bin.mjs generate offline --framework react --cwd /path/to/app --plan --json
Repeat with --apply to create files, then follow the generated README to connect them to your application
Use --package-source with prepared local snapshots to avoid fetching unpublished v3 packages
Read docs/cli/commands/boilerplate.md in the CLI documentation bundle for the complete local workflow
